candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 because its downstream call to order /v1/orders returns HTTP 500, so the order service is the failing dependency.
candidates.uncertainty: Order-side logs/metrics absent; the specific order failure mode (db, payment, inventory) is not established.

report.explanation: Every checkout 502 is paired with a gateway client call to order /v1/orders returning 500, and topology confirms gateway->order. The proximate failing component is order, but its internal cause is not yet observed, so only the http-500 candidate is bounded by current evidence.
missing_evidence: Order service logs and metrics for /v1/orders 500s to identify the failing internal dependency
Order dependency operation metrics (postgresql, payment, inventory) to distinguish db-pool-exhaustion vs downstream-latency
